name: @teamsuzie/people
description: A people directory built from email: who each person is, their organisation, role and relationship to the user, links between people and lasting facts, each kept only when its quoted evidence is really in the email; possible duplicates and merging; short summaries. Ported from Jeff Desk.

scripts.build: tsc && rm -rf dist/prompts && cp -R src/prompts dist/prompts
